pdb_path.description: Path to the input PDB structure.

mode.description: Operation to perform: score = REF2015 total_score; interface = InterfaceAnalyzerMover metrics; relax = FastRelax; pack = pack_rotamers.

score_fn.description: Rosetta score function tag (e.g., ref2015, ref2015_cart, beta_nov16).

chains_a.description: First side of the binding interface (chain ids, e.g. 'A'). Required for mode=interface.

chains_b.description: Second side of the binding interface (chain ids, e.g. 'B'). Required for mode=interface.

seed.description: Random seed forwarded to PyRosetta's `-constant_seed -jran` init flags.
